sources.author: Swyx
sources.headline: Founder at SmythOS, AI Agent Platform
sources.post_summary: Swyx discusses the evolution of AI agents, highlighting how multi-agent systems are transforming workflows beyond single-model chatbots. He shares insights on practical implementations using open-source tools and predicts widespread adoption in enterprise automation. Emphasizes the need for robust AI infrastructure to support scalable agentic architectures.

sources.author: Andrej Karpathy
sources.headline: Founder at Eureka Labs, ex-OpenAI
sources.post_summary: Karpathy explores developer tools for building AI agents, recommending frameworks like LangChain and CrewAI for rapid prototyping. He demonstrates a simple automation pipeline for code generation and debugging, stressing the importance of reliable evaluation metrics in agent performance.

sources.author: Nat Friedman
sources.headline: Co-Founder at GitHub (former)
sources.post_summary: Nat breaks down the AI infrastructure stack required for production-grade AI agents, from vector databases to orchestration layers. He critiques current limitations in scalability and proposes hybrid cloud-edge solutions for real-time automation in dev tools.

sources.author: Amanda Silverman
sources.headline: AI Product Lead at Microsoft
sources.post_summary: Silverman shares case studies on AI agents automating customer support and internal dev processes, using Azure's infrastructure. She highlights integration challenges with existing developer tools and tips for seamless deployment.

sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Founder & CEO at LangChain
sources.post_summary: Chase announces updates to LangGraph for building stateful AI agents, focusing on multi-step automation in developer workflows. Discusses how it simplifies AI infrastructure setup for complex agentic apps.

sources.author: Sami Rahman
sources.headline: Founder @ RevGenius | GTM Engineering Expert
sources.post_summary: Discusses building scalable GTM engines by integrating engineering with sales processes. Shares a framework for automating outbound at scale while maintaining personalization. Emphasizes data-driven iteration for revenue growth.

sources.author: Kyle Coleman
sources.headline: Head of Sales Operations @ Scale Startup
sources.post_summary: Outlines how sales ops teams can leverage automation tools to boost outbound efficiency without sacrificing lead quality. Provides case study from his experience scaling to $10M ARR. Recommends specific tech stack integrations.

sources.author: Anika Patel
sources.headline: Director of Revenue Operations @ Tech Unicorn
sources.post_summary: Explains the evolution of RevOps in aligning sales, marketing, and customer success. Details strategies for content-led GTM motions that drive pipeline. Includes metrics on ROI from unified ops platforms.

sources.author: Jordan Lee
sources.headline: Content Strategy Lead @ B2B SaaS
sources.post_summary: Breaks down a content strategy playbook for GTM teams focusing on thought leadership and demand gen. Shares tactics for repurposing content across outbound and inbound channels. Highlights A/B testing results for engagement uplift.

sources.author: Alex Rivera
sources.headline: VP of Sales Ops @ Growth-Stage Company
sources.post_summary: Argues for engineering outbound processes like software development with CI/CD pipelines. Details tools and workflows for sales ops to automate prospecting. Warns against common pitfalls in scaling automation.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Indie Maker & Founder of Nomad List, Remote OK
sources.post_summary: Pieter shared his latest product launch, a new tool for remote workers built entirely solo in a week. He detailed the tech stack, challenges faced during development, and initial user feedback. Emphasizes shipping fast over perfection in building in public.

sources.author: Arvid Kahl
sources.headline: Serial Entrepreneur, Author of The Embedded Entrepreneur
sources.post_summary: Arvid recounted pivoting from corporate job to bootstrapped SaaS founder, launching his first product after self-teaching coding. He outlined the 6-month journey, key learnings on solo development, and revenue milestones. Encourages others to build in public for accountability.

sources.author: KP (Karthik Pattabiraman)
sources.headline: Solo Founder & Indie Hacker
sources.post_summary: KP documented shipping his AI-powered newsletter tool as a one-person operation, from idea to 100+ paying users. He shared revenue numbers, marketing tactics used on LinkedIn, and advice for solo devs on prioritization. Highlights transparency in building in public.

sources.author: Sahil Lavingia
sources.headline: Founder of Gumroad
sources.post_summary: Sahil discussed his career pivot into tech during the pandemic, rebuilding Gumroad as a solo-ish founder focused on creator tools. He reflected on lessons from failures, the power of shipping MVPs publicly, and current growth metrics. Inspires founders to iterate openly.

sources.author: Daniel Vassallo
sources.headline: Ex-AWS, Indie Maker & Small Bets Advocate
sources.post_summary: Daniel shared stories of multiple small product launches post-AWS exit, emphasizing solo building and public updates. He detailed one product's path to $10k MRR and tips for tech career pivots via side projects. Focuses on sustainable solo entrepreneurship.
